items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Wright Smith was one of the violin players... And ever since he was a teacher, he organized this band. And he got really the best musicians available around Chicago at the time.

ctx.x: decided... He had heard Eddie South playing for the Rockefellers in Europe, and he was playing all them high-class gigs. And he thought it was time to put Eddie in one of them high-class hotels in Chicago. So they told him they'd organize a big band like Charles Elgar had, because now Eddie was the big violin player, was the star violin player -- and he was going to have a band like Charles Elgar. So Eddie wanted Charles Elgar to organize the band for him. And ever since he was a teacher, he organized this band.…

Well, we rehearsed... Eddie South is still in Europe, and this band is going to rehearse and get the gig together, so when Eddie comes back he can put the nucleus... He had Cliff King, and a guy named Wilson, Stanley Wilson on guitar, and a piano player named Antonia [Joe] Spaulding from Louisville, Kentucky. They were...
